subtitle: In a fractured Deccan, a child on a hill-fort begins to dream of Swaraj

panels.shot: epic bird's-eye of rugged Shivneri fort under monsoon clouds
panels.action: An 8–10-year-old Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj stands near the edge of Shivneri fort, wind tugging his simple clothes as he gazes over the misty Maval hills and scattered villages below, hands clenched with quiet resolve.

dialogue.text: On a rain-soaked hill called Shivneri, in a Deccan torn by many thrones, a jagirdar’s son named Shivaji began a journey that later storytellers would call the birth of Swaraj.

i18n.hi: बरसात में भीगा पहाड़ी किला शिवनेरी, और सिंहासन की मारकाट से फटा दक्खन… यहीं एक जमींदार का बेटा शिवाजी नाम से सफर शुरू करता है, जिसे बाद के किस्सों ने स्वराज की जन्मघड़ी कहा।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot from valley looking up at Shivneri fort
panels.action: Shivneri fort rises steep and stony above fields and the town of Junnar, its walls clinging to the cliff as tiny figures of peasants and pack animals move along the winding path below.

dialogue.text: The year remembered is 1630. Above the market town of Junnar, the rocky womb of Shivneri held a newborn whose name the Deccan did not yet know.

i18n.hi: साल माना जाता है १६३०। जुन्नर बाजार के ऊपर, पत्थर की कोख शिवनेरी ने एक नवजात को थामा, जिसका नाम दक्खन ने अभी सुना भी न था।

panels.shot: intimate interior mid-shot in a dim fort chamber
panels.action: Inside a stone chamber lit by a small oil lamp, Jijabai sits on a low cot cradling an infant Shivaji, her face tired yet intent, while a wet nurse and an older maid watch with quiet respect.

dialogue.text: Shahaji Bhonsle, Maratha general in Deccan service, was away on campaign. It was Jijabai, his politically sharp and deeply devout wife, who held the child and the fort together.

i18n.hi: शाहाजी भोसले, दक्खनी फौज में मराठी सरदार, मोर्चे पर दूर थे। किला और बच्चे – दोनों को थामे थीं जिजाबाई, तेज़ दिमाग और गहरी आस्था वाली उनकी अर्धांगिनी।

panels.shot: map-like overhead composite of the Deccan with inset vignettes
panels.action: A stylized map of the Deccan shows Bijapur, Ahmadnagar’s fading domain, Golconda and the Mughal advance; tiny vignettes show cavalry columns, court durbars, and village fields scattered between them.

dialogue.text: Around them, the Deccan was a chessboard of sultanates and the Mughal push from the north, with Maratha families like the Bhonsles serving, bargaining, and surviving between many overlords.

i18n.hi: चारों ओर दक्खन मानो शतरंज की बिसात था – सूबों के सुल्तान, उत्तर से धक्का मारते मुगल, और भोसले जैसे मराठा घराने, जो कई आकाओं के बीच सेवा, सौदेबाज़ी और जुगाड़ से जीते रहे।

panels.shot: slow push-in on Jijabai at a window overlooking the valley
panels.action: Jijabai stands at a small fort window, infant Shivaji asleep in a cradle beside her, as she gazes over the distant Maval hills where tiny smoke plumes rise from scattered hamlets.

dialogue.text: Maratha landlord lineages held jagirs and deshmukhi rights, their loyalties pulled between Bijapur, surviving Nizam Shahi claims, and rising Mughal power. Jijabai watched this world with unblinking eyes.

i18n.hi: मराठा जमींदार कुलों के पास जागीरें और देशमुखी हक़ थे; वफादारी कभी बीजापुर, कभी बची‑खुची निजामशाही, तो कभी बढ़ती मुगल ताकत की तरफ झूलती रही। जिजाबाई यह सब बिना पलक झपकाए देखती रहीं।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-wide of young boys training in a fort courtyard
panels.action: A 9–10-year-old Shivaji runs barefoot across the rough fort courtyard alongside peasant boys from nearby Maval, all wielding wooden sticks as mock spears while an older retainer corrects their stances.

dialogue.text: On Shivneri, the boy did not grow alone. Maval peasant lads drilled with him, their small clan networks shaping the circle of friends who would one day ride as his first companions.

i18n.hi: शिवनेरी पर वह बालक अकेला न बढ़ा। मावल के किसान लड़के उसके साथ कसरत करते, उनके छोटे कुल–कबीले ही उस दोस्त मंडली की जड़ बने, जो आगे चलकर उसके पहले साथी सवार होंगे।

panels.shot: close-up on young Shivaji’s focused face during play-training
panels.action: Sweat beads on young Shivaji’s brow as he grips a wooden stick like a sword, his eyes narrowed in concentration, lips pressed tight, while the blurred form of another boy rushes toward him.

dialogue.text: Later praise texts would exaggerate his childhood exploits, but the record agrees on this: he was disciplined early, taught to move, to watch, to read men and terrain together.

i18n.hi: बाद की स्तुति‑ग्रंथों ने उसके बचपन के कारनामे बढ़ा‑चढ़ा बताए, पर एक बात सब मानते हैं – उसे शुरू से ही कड़ी सिख मिलती रही: चलना, देखना, और आदमी व जमीन दोनों को साथ‑साथ पढ़ना।

panels.shot: warm interior mid-shot of mother and child at night
panels.action: In a lamplight glow, young Shivaji sits cross-legged beside Jijabai as she recounts a story with a steady hand raised, while he listens, eyes wide, a small wooden toy horse forgotten in his lap.

dialogue.text: At night, Jijabai became both storyteller and teacher, weaving Puranic tales, local memories and the sharp politics of their day into the mind of a boy who was learning to imagine power.

i18n.hi: रात को जिजाबाई ही किस्सागो भी थीं और गुरु भी; पुराण, गाँव की यादें और अपने समय की तीखी सियासत – सब मिलाकर वे उस बच्चे के दिमाग में ताकत की तस्वीरें उकेरतीं।

panels.shot: medium profile shot of Jijabai and Shivaji silhouetted against shrine lamps
panels.action: Jijabai and young Shivaji stand with folded hands before a simple household shrine, oil lamps flickering on the idol while the stone wall behind them bears faint traces of earlier fort life.

dialogue.text: Tradition remembers her as shaping his sense of dharma and kingship. Modern historians note how such memories grew later, yet agree: her presence and discipline left a deep imprint.

i18n.hi: परंपरा कहती है, वही उसके भीतर धर्म और राजधर्म की समझ गढ़ती हैं। आधुनिक इतिहासकार मानते हैं कि ये यादें बाद में बढ़ीं, पर इस पर सहमत हैं – उनकी मौजूदगी और अनुशासन ने गहरी छाप छोड़ी।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of boy and friends looking out from fort parapet
panels.action: Young Shivaji leans over the stone parapet with two Maval boys, pointing toward the distant hills and forests where faint paths thread between villages and isolated hillocks.

dialogue.text: Below Shivneri lay the Maval country, rugged and thinly controlled, where local leaders, small forts and peasant militias gave the land a stubborn, fractured independence.

i18n.hi: शिवनेरी के नीचे था मावल देश – ऊबड़‑खाबड़, कम काबू में; जहां छोटे नेता, गढ़ी किले और किसान टोलियां इस ज़मीन को अड़ियल, टुकड़ों में बंटी आज़ादी देते थे।

panels.shot: moody mid-shot of a Bijapur officer visiting the fort
panels.action: A Bijapur officer in distinct Deccan attire confers with a local fort official in the courtyard; in the background, women and children, including young Shivaji at a distance, glimpse them with curiosity.

dialogue.text: Shahaji served first the Nizam Shahs of Ahmadnagar, then shifted to Bijapur as powers rose and fell. Officers came and went, carrying orders, arrears, rumours of siege and betrayal.

i18n.hi: शाहाजी ने पहले अहमदनगर के निजामशाहों की सेवा की, फिर ताकतें बदलते वे बीजापुर जा जुड़े। फौजी अफ़सर आते‑जाते, साथ लाते हुक्म, बकाया तनख़्वाह, घेराबंदी और ग़द्दारी की खबरें।

panels.shot: composite of Shahaji on horseback against a battle-scarred plain
panels.action: A separate vignette shows Shahaji in armour atop a warhorse on an open plain, watching two distant armies maneuver, while tents and standards of different sultanates dot the horizon.

dialogue.text: Far from Shivneri, Shahaji rode between courts and campaigns, a skilled yet constrained general, his fortunes tied to rulers whose politics grew more uncertain with every Mughal advance.

i18n.hi: शिवनेरी से दूर, शाहाजी कभी दरबार तो कभी जंग के मैदान में घूमते, हुनरमंद पर बंधा हुआ सरदार, जिसकी किस्मत उन राजाओं से बंधी थी जिनकी सियासत हर मुगल बढ़त के साथ और डगमगाती।

panels.shot: sharp cut to a later-era kirtankar narrating to an audience
panels.action: Centuries later, a kirtankar stands on a village stage, arms raised, as villagers listen rapt; behind him an imagined scene of young Shivaji at a forest temple seems to glow in their minds.

dialogue.text: Much later, bards and bakhars would picture a boy at a shrine, vowing Swaraj before Rohideshwar. Their words turned a life of many steps into a single blazing moment.

i18n.hi: बहुत बाद को भाट और बख़रें एक बालक को देवस्थान पर खड़ा दिखाती हैं, रोहिदेश्वर पर स्वराज की सौगंध खाते हुए – कई पगों की लंबी ज़िंदगी को वे एक ही दहकते पल में समेट देते हैं।

panels.shot: evocative wide shot of Rohideshwar temple in the hills
panels.action: A small stone temple nestled amid the wooded Rohideshwar hill stands quiet under a pale sky, a simple path leading to it; imagined shadows of a young Shivaji and companions approach in the distance.

dialogue.text: The Rohideshwar temple became the stage for that remembered oath. Evidence is thin on exact words, but the memory itself reveals what later generations wanted his childhood to mean.

i18n.hi: रोहिदेश्वर का मंदिर उसी याद की रंगमंच बन गया। शब्दों का सबूत कम है, पर यह याद खुद बताती है कि बाद की संततियां उसके बचपन में क्या अर्थ देखना चाहती थीं।

panels.shot: medium shot of adolescent Shivaji at a shrine, rendered as a memory
panels.action: An adolescent Shivaji, shown in a slightly misted, memory-like style, stands before the Rohideshwar shrine with a few Maval youths, his hand resting lightly on the stone platform as they look up together.

dialogue.text: The phrase Hindavi Swarajya appears in these traditions: an idea of self-rule in a land of many peoples, later read back into the boy’s youth as if it had unfolded fully in one instant.

i18n.hi: इन परंपराओं में ‘हिंदवी स्वराज्य’ जैसा शब्द उभरता है – कई जातियों की भूमि में अपने राज का ख़याल, जिसे बाद वालों ने ऐसे जोड़ा जैसे वह पूरा विचार उसी क्षण बालक के मन में उतर आया हो।

panels.shot: tight close-up on young Shivaji’s thoughtful eyes
panels.action: In a close-up, young Shivaji’s eyes reflect both the flicker of a lamp and the outline of distant hills, his expression caught between childhood curiosity and a dawning seriousness.

dialogue.text: Historians, reading the early bakhars and annals, see no single founding vow, but they do see a pattern: a boy absorbing a world where loyalty was fragile and authority often distant.

i18n.hi: इतिहासकार, शुरुआती बखरों और दफ्तरी लेख पढ़कर, कोई एक स्थापना‑सौगंध नहीं देखते, पर एक ढर्रा ज़रूर दिखता है – एक लड़का जो सीख रहा है कि वफ़ादारी कितनी नाज़ुक और हुकूमत कितनी दूर की चीज़ होती है।

panels.shot: wide shot of Shivneri courtyard with structured drill
panels.action: In the Shivneri courtyard, adolescent Shivaji directs a small group of Maval youths in ordered practice, moving them with hand gestures as they run formations between stone walls and battlements.

dialogue.text: Between stories and skirmish games, between prayers and news from Shahaji’s shifting employers, Shivaji learned to knit friendship into discipline, and discipline into the early shape of a private force.

i18n.hi: कहानियों और नकली युद्ध‑खेलों के बीच, प्रार्थनाओं और शाहाजी के बदलते आकाओं की खबरों के बीच, शिवाजी ने दोस्ती को अनुशासन में, और अनुशासन को एक छोटी, निजी फौज की शक्ल में पिरोना सीखा।

panels.shot: low-angle mid-shot of Jijabai watching from a doorway
panels.action: From a dark doorway, Jijabai watches the youths training, her face unreadable but intent, one hand resting on the rough stone, the other lightly gripping her veil against the breeze.

dialogue.text: Sabhasad, writing decades later, would magnify each gesture into prophecy. Yet even stripped of praise, we find a mother carefully shaping a son for a dangerous, negotiated future.

i18n.hi: दशकों बाद लिखने वाला सब्हासद हर इशारे को भविष्यवाणी बना देता है। पर प्रशंसा हटाने पर भी दिखती है एक मां – जो बेटे को खतरनाक, सौदेबाज़ भविष्य के लिए बारीकी से गढ़ रही है।

panels.shot: sweeping wide shot from behind Shivaji looking over the Maval landscape at dusk
panels.action: At dusk atop Shivneri, young Shivaji stands with a few close companions, silhouettes against the fading sky, as the Maval valleys stretch out below in layers of shadow, hamlets glowing faintly with cooking fires.

dialogue.speaker: chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj
dialogue.text: So many hills, so many homes… who truly protects them?

i18n.hi: इतने पर्वत, इतने घर… इन्हें सच में कौन बचाता है?

panels.shot: gentle pull-back from Shivneri to a wider Deccan horizon
panels.action: The view pulls away from Shivneri, shrinking the fort against a vast horizon where distant cities, camps, and roads hint at the larger powers that still dominate the land.

dialogue.text: No single oath on a hillside began Shivaji’s Swaraj. It began in Shivneri’s stone rooms and Maval’s rough fields, as a child learned that great public lives are forged in private discipline and shared purpose.

i18n.hi: किसी एक पहाड़ी कसम से शिवाजी का स्वराज शुरू नहीं हुआ। वह शुरू हुआ शिवनेरी की पत्थर कोठरियों और मावल के ऊबड़ खेतों में, जब एक बच्चा समझने लगा कि बड़ी सार्वजनिक ज़िंदगियां निजी अनुशासन और साझे मकसद में ढलती हैं।

title_i18n.en: Shivneri Son and the Rohideshwar Oath
title_i18n.hi: शिवनेरी पुत्र और रोहिदेश्वर की प्रतिज्ञा

subtitle_i18n.en: In a fractured Deccan, a child on a hill-fort begins to dream of Swaraj
subtitle_i18n.hi: टूटे बिखरे दक्खन में, एक किले पर बच्चा स्वराज के सपने बुनने लगा
